data.title: Where the numbers come from
data.intro: Plans are calculated by a fixed rules engine from these data. AI is used only in the helper and does not affect plans.
data.power: NASA POWER — daily temperature and rain: frost-free days, rain April–September, hot days.
data.soilgrids: ISRIC SoilGrids v2.0 — soil texture and pH when you answer «don't know».
data.modis: MODIS MOD10A1 v6.1 — daily snow cover in mountain basins, compared with the multi-year norm for the date.
data.osm: OpenStreetMap — base map and settlements (ODbL). Esri World Imagery — satellite.
data.crops: Crop water needs, soil fit and the 1–5 income index are approximate values (FAO-56 style) and will be replaced by verified sources.
data.demo: Demo: snow labels and basin outlines are synthetic until the daily MODIS job is connected.
assistant.title: Helper
assistant.note: The helper explains the app, it does not make plans
err.rate_limited: Too many attempts, wait a minute
assistant.sow: I don't choose crops. The Plans screen (step 4) calculates rotation options for your field, and the decision is always yours.
app.installIos: In Safari tap Share, then «Add to Home Screen»
map.outsideKg: Kyrgyzstan only: choose a place inside the country
plot.hereDenied: Allow location access in your browser settings
plot.hereHint: Stand in the middle of your field and tap — the plot appears around you.
help.prev: Choose the crop that took most of the field. If the field rested or you don't remember, choose «Nothing / don't know».
help.source: Where the summer irrigation water for this field comes from. A canal fed by a river counts as «River / canal». If only rain waters the field, choose «No irrigation».
help.water: «Enough» — you water whenever needed. «Sometimes not enough» — queues or cuts in hot weeks. «Often not enough» — short of water almost every summer.
help.soil: Roll some moist soil into a ball. Falls apart — sandy. Holds its shape but cracks — medium. Smooth and sticky, rolls into a sausage — clay.
plans.vsSame: about as much water as {crop} every year
snow.plain.low: Less snow in the mountains than usual — there may be less water in rivers and canals this summer. The plans take this into account.
snow.plain.normal: Mountain snow is close to usual — summer water will likely be like in a normal year.
snow.plain.high: More snow in the mountains than usual — rivers and canals usually have more water in summer.
snow.plain.notUsed: Well water or no irrigation — mountain snow does not affect these plans.
snow.notForecast: Not a forecast: a comparison with snow in past years.
onboard.1.title: Find your village
onboard.1.text: Type its name in the search at the top. If you are on the field right now, tap «I'm on my field».
onboard.2.title: Mark your field
onboard.2.text: Tap your field on the map. Drag the corners so the outline matches the field — the area is calculated for you.
onboard.3.title: Answer the questions
onboard.3.text: What you sowed, where the water comes from, the soil and what matters most. Not sure? Tap «?» next to the question.
onboard.4.title: Choose a plan
onboard.4.text: You get 3 plans for 3 years. Swipe right to save, left to skip. It's a suggestion — the decision is yours.
priority.water.desc: Plans that need less irrigation. Useful when water is short.
priority.income.desc: More weight on crops with higher income (approximate prices).
priority.soil.desc: Legumes and rotations that restore the soil.
priority.hint: This changes how plans are ranked, not the data about your field.
